facts.activity_file: setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices

assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unrelieved potential energy found after isolation of PSV-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on PSV-4110 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. PSV-4110 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 8 June 2026 a high potential incident was recorded on PSV-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during start-up after maintenance; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
